metadata.title: PolySwarm - FileHash Enrichment - Incident Triggered
metadata.description: Takes every FileHash entity on a Microsoft Sentinel incident, looks it up in the PolySwarm REST API v3, and writes a verdict / PolyScore / engine / malware-family / sandbox / ATT&CK summary back to the incident as a comment.
prerequisites: A PolySwarm API key with access to the target community, stored as a secret in an Azure Key Vault. Get a key at https://polyswarm.network/account/api-keys
The Key Vault must have 'enabledForTemplateDeployment' set to true, or the connection resource deploys against RBAC only, which is the default and sufficient here.
postDeployment: 1. Grant this playbook's system-assigned managed identity the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on the Key Vault named in KeyVaultName.
2. Assign the 'Microsoft Sentinel Responder' role on the resource group (or workspace) to this playbook's system-assigned managed identity.
3. Authorize the Microsoft Sentinel and Key Vault API connections if they show as unauthorized.
4. Attach the playbook to an automation rule so it runs when an incident is created.

metadata.description: Name of the Logic App playbook resource.
Version string sent in the User-Agent header on every call to the PolySwarm API. Bump this when the solution version changes.
Name of the Azure Key Vault holding the PolySwarm API key. The vault must exist in the same subscription; grant this playbook's managed identity 'Key Vault Secrets User' on it after deployment.
Name of the secret in KeyVaultName that holds the PolySwarm API key.
PolySwarm community to search. Use 'default' unless you have a private community.
PolySwarm REST API v3 base URL.

PolyScore at or above which the comment reports 'Malicious', used only when the API returns no explicit verdict. Scores at or above half this value report 'Suspicious'. Passed as a string because ARM templates have no float parameter type.

Get_PolySwarm_API_Key.description: Reads the PolySwarm API key from Azure Key Vault through this playbook's system-assigned managed identity. The identity needs the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on the vault named in KeyVaultName.

Search_PolySwarm_hash.description: Primary lookup. Returns the scan instance: verdict, PolyScore, detection counts, the full per-engine assertions array, arbiter votes, PolyUnite classification, PE metadata and a permalink.

Search_PolySwarm_artifact_metadata.description: Best-effort secondary lookup against the artifact index. Adds classification tags, normalised families and sandbox intelligence (CAPE and Triage scores, MITRE ATT&CK techniques) that the hash lookup does not carry. Failures are tolerated: the enrichment comment is still posted using the hash-lookup data alone. Delete this action and Select_artifact_metadata_record to halve the API calls per hash.

Select_artifact_metadata_record.description: HTTP 204 (empty body, not found) is branched on explicitly and yields no metadata record; any other outcome of the best-effort call is tolerated.

Build_summary.description: Single point of truth for field extraction. Every value coalesces across the hash-lookup scan record and the artifact-metadata record, so the comment degrades cleanly if either source is missing a field.

body.message:
PolySwarm enrichment
Hash (@{toUpper(outputs('Determine_hash_type'))}): @{replace(replace(replace(replace(string(items('For_each_file_hash')?['Value']), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"')}
Assessment: @{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['state'], 'KNOWN_GOOD'), 'Known good (PolySwarm lists this file as known non-malware, for example a test file or a trusted vendor file, even if some engines flag it)', if(or(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['total'], null), equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['total'], 0)), 'Unknown', if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['polyscore'], null), 'Unknown', if(greaterOrEquals(outputs('Build_summary')?['polyscore'], float(parameters('PolySwarmMaliciousThreshold'))), 'Malicious', if(greaterOrEquals(outputs('Build_summary')?['polyscore'], div(float(parameters('PolySwarmMaliciousThreshold')), 2)), 'Suspicious', 'Likely benign')))))} (PolyScore @{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['polyscore'], null), 'n/a', formatNumber(outputs('Build_summary')?['polyscore'], '0.0000'))})
Detections: @{outputs('Build_summary')?['malicious']} malicious / @{outputs('Build_summary')?['benign']} benign of @{outputs('Build_summary')?['total']} engines
@{if(empty(outputs('Build_summary')?['engines']), '', concat('Malicious engines: ', replace(replace(replace(replace(string(join(outputs('Build_summary')?['engines'], ', ')), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '
'))}Malware family: @{replace(replace(replace(replace(string(coalesce(outputs('Build_summary')?['malwareFamily'], 'n/a')), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"')}
@{if(empty(outputs('Build_summary')?['labels']), '', concat('Labels: ', replace(replace(replace(replace(string(join(outputs('Build_summary')?['labels'], ', ')), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '
'))}@{if(empty(outputs('Build_summary')?['tags']), '', concat('Tags: ', replace(replace(replace(replace(string(join(outputs('Build_summary')?['tags'], ', ')), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '
'))}@{if(empty(outputs('Build_summary')?['sandboxFamilies']), '', concat('Sandbox-reported family: ', replace(replace(replace(replace(string(join(outputs('Build_summary')?['sandboxFamilies'], ', ')), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '
'))}@{if(and(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['capeScore'], null), equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['triageScore'], null)), '', concat('Sandbox scores: CAPE ', coalesce(string(outputs('Build_summary')?['capeScore']), 'n/a'), ' / Triage ', coalesce(string(outputs('Build_summary')?['triageScore']), 'n/a'), '
'))}@{if(empty(outputs('Build_summary')?['ttps']), '', concat('MITRE ATT&CK: ', join(outputs('Build_summary')?['ttps'], ', '), '
'))}@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['fileType'], null), '', concat('File type: ', string(outputs('Build_summary')?['fileType']), '
'))}@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['imphash'], null), '', concat('Imphash: ', string(outputs('Build_summary')?['imphash']), '
'))}@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['packer'], null), '', concat('Packer: ', string(outputs('Build_summary')?['packer']), '
'))}@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['firstSeen'], null), '', concat('First seen: ', string(outputs('Build_summary')?['firstSeen']), ' | Last seen: ', coalesce(string(outputs('Build_summary')?['lastSeen']), 'n/a'), '
'))}@{coalesce(outputs('Build_attribution_line'), '')}PolySwarm report: @{replace(replace(replace(replace(string(coalesce(outputs('Build_summary')?['permalink'], concat('https://polyswarm.network/scan/results/file/', outputs('Build_summary')?['sha256']))), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"')}

Search_PolySwarm_tags_link.description: Optional attribution lookup. HTTP 204 with an empty body is the normal answer and means no attribution; it posts nothing extra. A failure of this call never fails the run or suppresses the enrichment comment.

Build_attribution_line.description: One escaped line of attribution tags, or empty when the lookup returned 204, failed, or listed no tags.

Add_enrichment_comment_to_incident_unles.description: Microsoft Sentinel can answer 409 when several playbooks comment on one incident at once, even though the comment was saved. A 409 is left alone; any other failure posts the comment once more.
